name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing plus an explicit-only UltraBurn mode for bounded high-compute engineering runs.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-gated Sol delivery with a separate manual UltraBurn mode.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate may select role-pinned GPT-6 Luna / Max and Terra / High implementers for independently owned, non-substantial work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6.1 Sol / High review; full uses the useful set of selected implementers and a fresh review for substantial delegated work or when breadth or risk warrants it. Parallelism follows dependencies, disjoint ownership, specialization, and observed runtime capacity; it has no policy headcount ceiling. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed. A separate explicit-only UltraBurn skill requires GPT-6.1 Sol / Ultra and adds time-bounded discovery, durable status/stop state, isolated workstreams, and fresh read-only Ultra review without changing normal routes.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; use audit for substantial root implementation, and full for substantial delegated work or when breadth or risk warrants it.
Use $sol-advisor:ultraburn only when I explicitly request a manual high-compute plan, run, status, or stop operation.
